problem: Weighted SPLINE and HATCH spline edges previously drew the unweighted control polygon approximation despite retained weights.
implementation: For finite positive weights and open-clamped nonperiodic degree 1–3 splines with supported knots, convert to homogeneous Bezier pieces and adaptively split until the projected control hull is within 1e-4 of control extent from each chord, subject to finite-value checks, maximum depth 16 and 8192 segments. Internal line-intersection junctions are retained once. Unsupported or over-budget cases retain the existing fallback and warning.

validation.geometry: 24/24 focused Bezier/spline tests pass, including rational quarter circle, weighted nonuniform 3D points and cubic midpoint independently evaluated by ezdxf 1.4.5, line intersection, exact joins and invalid-weight fallback.
validation.negativeControl: Quarter-circle rational source produced one unweighted segment before the change; an exact interior junction was missed before the intersection correction.
validation.hatch: 2/2 focused rational/ordinary HATCH controls pass with the bundled codec, including selected region line intersections, movement and ASCII/Binary save/reopen. Nine HATCH/MPOLYGON controls and three standalone spline controls pass with the current shared codec using separate scratch integration.
validation.planSync: explicit-path plan validation passed in the complete source tree.

limits: Approximation is not an exact NURBS representation; rational import warning remains.
Periodic, nonpositive or invalid weights, unsupported knots or degree, and over-budget curves fall back to previous behavior.
Native GUI, other platforms, general 3D intersections and final integration remain open.
No generated DWG/DXF fixtures were committed.
